scripts.dev: bun run dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,web -c blue,green "bun run --cwd apps/backend dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.dev:backend: bun run dev:prepare && bun run --cwd apps/backend dev
scripts.debug: bun run dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,web -c blue,green "bun run --cwd apps/backend debug" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/db db:generate && bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/ui/overlay-engine typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/backend typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,web -c blue,green "bun run --cwd apps/backend start" "bun run --cwd apps/web start"
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up -d --build postgres --wait && bun run secrets:sync
scripts.db:prepare: bun run db:up && bun run --cwd packages/db db:generate && bun run --cwd packages/db db:deploy
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml stop postgres
scripts.db:setup: bun run db:up && cd packages/db && bun run db:migrate
scripts.db:reset: bun run db:down && bun run db:up && cd packages/db && bun run db:reset
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/backend test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.lint: eslint apps/backend packages scripts docker && bun run --cwd apps/web lint
scripts.lint:fix: eslint apps/backend packages scripts docker --fix && bun run --cwd apps/web lint --fix
scripts.storage:up: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up -d --build garage --wait && bun run secrets:sync
scripts.dev:prepare: bun run storage:up && bun run db:prepare
